decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component technology that builds directly on the firm's tube and exchanger know-how and in-house R&D, so the firm can interpret field and service feedback and keep improving the product rather than abandon it, even though several sibling 2018 launches were removed.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes sit at the heart of the firm's thermal engineering knowledge and benefit from its own R&D and research cooperation, making them a platform the firm can absorb learning into and keep on the market.
